title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (80,000 affected)
summary: THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM HIGH PRESSURE HOSE MAY LEAK OR DETACH AT ITS CRIMPED END FITTING RESULTING IN THE DISCHARGE OF HYDRAULIC FLUID.

title: KOLCRAFT ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (164,385 affected)
summary: THE BOTTOM CUSHION OF THE CHILD SAFETY SEAT FAILED TO MEET THE FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.

title: Ford Motor Company: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (792,000 affected)
summary: WHEN THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER IS PLACED IN THE PARK POSITION, THE PARK PAWL DOES NOT ALWAYS ABUT OR ENGAGE THE PARK GEAR.

title: Mazda North American Operations: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (33,540 affected)
summary: WHEN THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER IS PLACED IN THE PARK POSITION, THE PARK PAWL DOES NOT ALWAYS ABUT OR ENGAGE THE PARK GEAR.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:121 BRAKE SYSTEM (104 affected)
summary: THE REAR TANDEM AXLE BRAKES DO NOT MEET THE SERVICE BRAKE APPLICATION TIME REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 121.

title: HEHR INTERNATIONAL: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT (650 affected)
summary: THE WINDOWS DO NOT MEET THE RETENTION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 217. THE EXIT CATCH PULLED LOOSE BEFORE THE WINDOW BROKE.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (2,873 affected)
summary: THE FAN BLADE OR THE FAN SHROUD CAN FRACTURE DUE TO INSUFFICIENT FORE AND AFT CLEARANCE IN THE LOWER AREA OF THE FAN SHROUD.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:TRUNK CARGO LIGHTS (19,688 affected)
summary: A WASHER IN THE CARGO AREA LIGHT MAY NOT BE PROPERLY ATTACHED, AND MAY HAVE FALLEN IN THE CARGO LIGHT DURING ASSEMBLY. IF THIS OCCURRED, AND THE THREE POSITION LIGHT SWITCH IS IN THE MIDDLE POSITION, AND THE TAILGATE IS OPEN, THE WASHER CAN CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE LIGHT.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (162,967 affected)
summary: THE BLACK PLASTIC PUSH PINS USED TO ATTACH THE PADS TO SEAT STRUCTURE CAN BE REMOVED BY CHILDREN.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:PUMP (13,000 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRONICALLY CONTROLLED MOTOR PUMP POWER STEERING SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION, CAUSING INTERMITTENT LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST AND REQUIRING VARYING DEGREES OF INCREASED STEERING EFFORT.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:121 BRAKE SYSTEM (83 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT EXERT SUFFICIENT FORCE TO ENABLE THE VEHICLE TO CONFORM TO THE GRADE HOLDING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 121.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (38,000 affected)
summary: THE RIGHT FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY RUB AGAINST THE TIRE DURING A FULL LOCK LEFT TURN, WHICH MAY EVENTUALLY CAUSE WEAR THROUGH OF THE BRAKE HOSE ON THE RIGHT FRONT SIDE.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (6,866 affected)
summary: THE CONSOLE MOUNTED SHIFT LEVER MAY DISENGAGE FROM THE SHIFT CONTROL CABLE BRACKET CAUSING LOSS OF GEAR INDICATOR REFERENCE AND SHIFT SELECTOR OPERATION.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY (610 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS THE FORCE NECESSARY TO OPEN THE REAR EMERGENCY DOOR EXCEEDS 40 POUNDS.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (51,000 affected)
summary: A CRACK CAN DEVELOP IN THE FUEL TANK ADJACENT TO A SEAM WELD IN THE REAR OF THE TANK.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (65 affected)
summary: THE SEAT BELT LATCH MECHANISM IS NOT EASILY ACCESSIBLE TO THE OCCUPANT OF THE FRONT PASSENGER SEAT.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (55 affected)
summary: THE PINCH BOLT USED TO RETAIN THE PITMAN ARM TO THE STEERING GEAR MAY NOT MEET THE HEAT TREAT SPECIFICATION FOR A GRADE 8 FASTENER AND MAY STRIP BEFORE PROPER TORQUE IS ACHIEVED.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (272 affected)
summary: THE BOLTS AND NUTS WHICH ATTACH THE BEARING-HUB ASSEMBLY TO THE REAR AXLE FLANGE ARE NOT SUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED ON SOME VEHICLES.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:121 BRAKE SYSTEM (171 affected)
summary: THE EXISTING INTERLOCK AIR BRAKE SYSTEM MUST GET ITS AIR SUPPLY DIRECTLY FROM THE PARKING BRAKE AIR SUPPLY CIRCUIT. SHOULD A COMPONENT FAILURE OCCUR IN THE INTERLOCK AIR SYSTEM, IT WILL DEPLETE THE AIR SUPPLY FROM THE PARKING BRAKE CIRCUIT.

title: PAS, INC.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC (401 affected)
summary: THE LINK CONNECTING THE ELECTRONIC REAR HEIGHT SENSOR TO THE REAR AXLE CAN DISCONNECT UNDER SEVERAL CONDITIONS, ALLOWING THE ARM ATTACHED TO THE SENSOR TO LODGE BETWEEN THE REAR AXLE ASSEMBLY AND THE RIGHT REAR BRAKE PIPE. THIS ABRADES THE BRAKE PIPE AND COULD LEAD TO REAR BRAKE FAILURE.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (722,884 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SHOULDER BELT RETRACTORS MAY HAVE REDUCED SENSITIVITY OF THE LOCK-UP FEATURE AND WOULD NOT FUNCTION IN A SUDDEN DECELERATION OR CRASH.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: STEERING:COLUMN (62 affected)
summary: THE PINCH BOLT CONNECTING THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN TO THE LOWER STEERING COLUMN MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TIGHTENED AND SEPARATION OF UPPER AND LOWER STEERING COLUMNS CAN OCCUR.
